Hardware tag starvation (BLK_STS_RESOURCE): queue depth 2 exhausted, third request remains pending in dispatch list
Hardware tag reclamation cycle: device completion frees tag 0, allowing pending starved request to acquire tag and dispatch
MQ-DEADLINE scheduler: expired read deadline (300us) preempts older unexpired write (3000us) during hardware dispatch
Concurrent multi-core plug batching: independent CPU plugs performing parallel back and front merges across 2 hardware contexts
